📊 What moved today, Tuesday 10 November

📉 Unemployment edged up to 33.7% in July to September, even though 101,000 jobs were added.
⛽ Oil slipped to about $91.60 a barrel, its lowest since early September, on hopes of a US-Iran deal, which keeps December's petrol cut on track.
💱 The rand held near R16.39 to the dollar; the JSE Top 40 was up about 0.3% late in the day.

Levels are late-afternoon snapshots. Education, not financial advice.
